title: Design a URL Shortener
summary: Design a URL shortening service like bit.ly that can handle millions of URLs.
body:
Design a URL shortening service like bit.ly that can handle millions of URLs.

## Scenario

Design a URL shortening service that takes long URLs and creates short aliases. When users visit the short URL, they should be redirected to the original.

## Requirements

- Generate unique short URLs from long URLs
- Redirect short URLs to original URLs with low latency
- Support custom short URLs
- Track click analytics (count, referrer, location)
- Handle 100M new URLs per month

## Constraints

- Short URL should be at most 7 characters
- URLs should not be guessable
- System should be highly available (99.9%)
- Redirects should complete in < 100ms

## What a strong answer covers

- Hash/encoding strategy for short URL generation
- Database schema and sharding strategy
- Caching layer design
- Analytics pipeline
- Rate limiting and abuse prevention

## Reference walkthrough

Use Base62 encoding of an auto-incrementing counter (distributed via Zookeeper ranges). Store mappings in a sharded NoSQL database (key: shortUrl, value: longUrl). Add a Redis cache layer for hot URLs. Use Kafka for async analytics event processing. CDN for global low-latency redirects.
keyTakeaways: Hash/encoding strategy for short URL generation
